description_en: Applies for a public endpoint for a Data Warehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 为数仓版集群申请公网连接地址
name: AllocateClusterPublicConnection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the public endpoint.
It must start with a lowercase letter and consist of lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
It can be up to 30 characters in length.
The default value is the cluster name
parameters.help_zh:
公网连接地址的前缀。
由小写字母开头，必须包含小写字母、数字和中划线（-）组成。
长度不超过30个字符。
默认使用集群名
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix
